milestone: TC-LAYERED-1 — responsiveness pass on BASELINE-88573ef0, one toggleable layer at a time (owner, 21 Oct)
status: PRESENTED for the owner's hands-on review — NOT frozen, NOT integrated
local_only: the character is a real player's model — never publish
all_off_equals_88573ef0: 233/233 runs identical (hash, contacts, actions) — also with B1 only (presentation); in Chrome the same input through A, B1 and the locked engine gives one hash

layers.B1 ack: presentation only: head / pelvis / torso / leans / knee flex / next support foot toward the new line, bounded
layers.B2 early: next carry touch brought forward by a shortened step (useful, not busy, no magic foot: swing ≤ 1.3 × natural + 1 m/s)
layers.B2 prefFoot: the other foot whenever the lane foot is > 0.10 s later on a turn (baseline 0.35 s)
layers.B2 approach: angled approach instead of holding the old line
layers.B3 narrow: technique committed only in its final approach (45–80 ms, from its own swing); no set-touch commitment; re-timing allowed
layers.B4 generic: compact inside / outside redirect, across-body gather, urgent reach, braking touch, braking pivot on the carry's tracker with anchored plants; named moves scored on real exit quality
layers.B5 exits: control back at the end of the striking foot's follow-through (0.06–0.14 s); no exit lock
layers.B5 windups: Cruyff / hook / drag-back opened at their plant when already slow
layers.B6 target: technique touches sized to where the body plays the ball next (±15°, 0.6–1.5 × speed)

body_warnings: surfaced live on the page and in the report card, never acted on; 88573ef0 has its own (pelvis ↔ root up to 0.44 m, chop exit touch from a planted foot, clearance jitter); B2 / B4 add foot jumps and leg crossings in rapid input / circles, B6 adds contact gaps at sprint turns
agility_movement_dependencies: sprint 90 / 120° turns: generic actions run on the tracker (turn rate = lateral accel / speed ≈ 79°/s at 8 m/s, braking only > 50°) — they cannot turn as sharply as the chop's authored motion
sprint 180°: braking 9.5 m/s² + acceleration 7 m/s² set the floor (no layer moved it)
rapid L/R at sprint: the body cannot follow an earlier redirect faster than its lateral limit
decision_owner: hands-on review: which layers help, which hurt
